On August 29, 2026 , the Süper Lig spotlight turned to the clash between Gazişehir Gaziantep and Besiktas . Both teams entered the pitch with high ambitions, setting the stage for a match filled with strategic maneuvers and late drama. Early Blitz and Clinical Finishing The visitors established their authority early in the contest, breaking the deadlock in the 12th minute. Mithat Pala provided a brilliant assist for Emrecan Bulut , who clinical finish gave his side the lead. The pressure didn't stop there; in the 35th minute, Emrecan Bulut turned provider, setting up Ali Sowe to double the advantage. Besiktas appeared to be in total control as the first half concluded, despite Gazişehir Gaziantep attempting to shift momentum by introducing Serdar Dursun before the break. Tactical Adjustments and Rising Tension The second half saw both managers delve deep into their benches to refresh the energy on the field. Gazişehir Gaziantep made a triple substitution in the 65th minute, bringing on Valentin Mihaila , Enver Kulasin , and Kerim Calhanoglu . As the intensity grew, the referee was forced to reach for his pocket, issuing yellow cards to Attila Mocsi and Enver Kulasin . The match became a battle of attrition in the midfield, with neither side willing to yield ground in the final stages of the game. Late Misfortune and Final Whistle In the dying moments of the match, the home side's frustrations were compounded by a defensive error. In the 91st minute, Zakaria Ariss inadvertently sent the ball into his own net, effectively ending any hopes of a late comeback. Stoppage time also saw Dal Varesanovic receive a yellow card as tensions boiled over briefly. When the final whistle blew on this August 29, 2026 fixture, it confirmed a professional and decisive performance from the visitors in the Süper Lig .
